programs.title: Air Crash Investigations: The Accident Files
programs.desc: Mistaken identity and hostile fire over enemy territory are among the many risks that pilots face in war zones around the world. An Iranian passenger plane is blown out of the sky by a missile fired from a US warship. A tragic explosion rocks a massive military plane carrying Vietnamese orphans to safety. And, a cargo flight is crippled by a surface-to-air missile over wartorn Iraq.
